evidence: packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:42-50: deleteCacheMutation.onSuccess only toasts and calls onSuccess?.(); there is no utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.invalidate(), unlike disconnectMutation's onSettled (lines 61-64). packages/features/eventtypes/components/tabs/advanced/EventAdvancedTab.tsx:372-383 renders SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper without onChanged, and the dropdown still shows the cache items there (hasCache doesn't depend on disableConnectionModification). After deleting the cache in that view, the 'Cache status / last updated' entry stays stale. CalendarListContainer.tsx:79-88 does pass an onChanged that invalidates, so only callers without onChanged are affected.

CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:88-91 hardcodes new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...) even though the text around it is translated with t(). Other components use the runtime locale from useLocale().i18n.language (e.g. packages/features/ee/video/ViewRecordingsDialog.tsx:174, packages/features/ee/workflows/pages/workflow.tsx:186). Non-English users get a US-formatted timestamp inside a localized string. Low severity but an easy fix.

deleteCache.handler.ts:17-22 checks credential.userId === user.id. The only UI entry point is the connectedCalendars list, built from getUsersCredentialsIncludeServiceAccountKey (packages/lib/server/getUsersCredentials.ts:13-22, where: { userId: user.id }) plus delegation credentials. Team-owned credentials never appear in this list, so no team-credential flow is blocked. Adding teamId authorization would be a speculative feature, not a bug fix.

scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:28-31: when tmole is already running, TUNNEL_URL comes from grep on /tmp/tmole.log. If the log is missing (tmole started manually), grep prints an error, TUNNEL_URL is empty, and lines 56-59 print 'Failed to extract Tunnelmole URL' and exit. The script can't learn the URL any other way, so failing is the right outcome. The only gaps are the confusing message and a possibly stale log. Dev-only helper script, low impact.

scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:69: sed -i '' -E "s|...|" "$ENV_FILE". GNU sed only accepts an attached -i suffix, so '' is parsed as the (empty) script and the s|...| expression is treated as a filename. On Linux this errors ('can't read s|^GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL=...'), .env is not updated, and the script still prints the '✅ Updated' message on line 74. A portable form such as sed -i.bak ... && rm file.bak works on both BSD and GNU sed.

apps/web/package.json:11 changes dev:cron to 'npx tsx cron-tester.ts'. tsx is not declared in the root or apps/web package.json and node_modules/.bin/tsx does not exist, so npx fetches whatever version is current from the network on each run: not reproducible and fails offline. Adding tsx as a devDependency is better, but this is a dev-only script.
scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:41 'for i in {1..20}' never uses i. This is a ShellCheck SC2034-style lint with no behavioral impact; renaming to _ is cosmetic.

calendar-cache.repository.mock.ts:27-30 declares getCacheStatusByCredentialIds() with no parameters. TypeScript lets an implementation with fewer parameters satisfy an interface method (parameter bivariance/arity rules), so this compiles. It also matches the sibling mock methods in the same file (e.g. deleteManyByCredential() at line 23, which also omits its interface params). Adding the param is cosmetic only.

connectedCalendars.handler.ts:27: credentialId comes from connectedCalendars items where it is typed as a required number, so there are no missing values. Duplicate IDs inside Prisma's `in` filter (calendar-cache.repository.ts:176) are harmless: SQL IN dedupes semantically and groupBy returns one row per credentialId. No guard is needed.

_router.tsx:29 uses z.object({ credentialId: z.number() }), which accepts floats and negatives. However, deleteCache.handler.ts:17-26 does findFirst({ id, userId }) and throws if nothing is found, so invalid IDs can't cause harm. Other credentialId schemas in the codebase also use plain z.number() (availability/calendarOverlay.schema.ts:9, apps/updateAppCredentials.schema.ts:4). .int().positive() is optional hardening only.

calendar-cache.repository.ts:173-188 runs groupBy even when credentialIds is empty. Prisma handles `in: []` by returning no rows, so behavior is correct. An early return only saves one round-trip for users with no calendars. Deduplication adds no value (see id 8). Minor micro-optimization.
